Legacy command intent:

ViewBS MethCoverage --sample sample.tab,WT --reference reference.fa --outdir out --prefix coverage

Expected output provenance:

The local legacy Perl entrypoint cannot be executed in this environment because Getopt::Long::Subcommand is not installed. This fixture follows the checked-in legacy implementation in lib/Meth/Coverage.pm and the reference context counting behavior covered by the Rust test suite:

- count cytosine depth by context;
- when zero-depth cytosines are absent, use reference-derived context counts as denominators;
- emit reverse cumulative coverage percentages by context and depth;
- preserve integer percentage formatting.
